verdict.rationale: Intel's official Gaudi documentation covers running the Gaudi Docker image, PyTorch training and inference, DeepSpeed, distributed training, and vLLM/SGLang serving. Intel's product pages also state that Gaudi is integrated with PyTorch and supports Hugging Face resources, so the core of the story is officially documented. missing for 10: an explicit published support/version matrix (framework, driver and OS versions) in the evidence, and independent hands-on confirmation that these framework builds work in practice.
